title: Pain O' Plenty
description: A mod-pack to turn up the difficulty to the max.
body:
![The logo for the modpack, "Pain O' Plenty"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/846184e6be0c0fa6fd6c582700ffe3e847d38343.png) 
# Hell on Earth.

Ever had one of those two-week phases where you play the game? Ever said to yourself: "Man, I hate this game, it's too fun."

**_THEN THIS IS THE MOD-PACK FOR YOU!!_**

Featuring features such as:
- **No Tree Punching**! Better protect those knuckles.
- **Enhanced AI**! Now you actually have a reason to be scared of mobs!
- **Fire Arrows Ignite Fire**! Just to burn your house down! ~~NOT~~ fun!
- **Tough As Nails**! Just so you can die of dehydration AND hypothermia at the SAME time.
- **Nyf's Spiders**! To fully enable your arachnophobia, they can now crawl on ceilings.
- **FirstAid**! Now instead of having a health bar, you get one-shot by an arrow to the head.
  
## BUT THAT'S NOT ALL!
Ever felt like you could see too much at night? BAM! Now you can't see anything!

Feel like the difficulty is too high? TOO BAD, it's locked to hard mode, deal with it.

### For the fun parts.
This modpack contains Origins, including the Origins: Classes addon for a fresher experience. This has also been paired with Epic Fight and Spartan Weaponry/Shields for a great combat experience, aswell as a progression plan with the Epic Fight: Skill Tree Addon.

I hope this modpack fulfils your needs to not enjoy the game.
